title: Quiltor capabilities v1
description: The answer of GET /api/capabilities: what the client may offer on this server (D-58, D-59). The client branches on these flags, never on an operation profile, which is deliberately not on the wire. `instance` holds facts that are the same for everyone on the server; `user` holds facts of the asking session. Both accept further booleans, so a new flag is additive; a client ignores flags it does not know.

multiUser.description: More than one identity signs in here (OIDC). For diagnostics and wording only; branch on the flags below.

signOut.description: The client may offer signing out.

deviceSync.description: Worlds may sync with another device through a backup endpoint (D-61).

assistantInstall.description: A request may install the assistant runtime and model on this server.

writingDataInstall.description: A request may install the dictionary data on this server.

grammarInstall.description: A request may install LanguageTool on this server.

user.description: Flags of the asking session; they can change with a token refresh, so the client re-reads them.

serverAi.description: This session may use the server-side assistant (the premium role on a shared server, always locally). Allowed, not reachable: reachability stays in /api/assistant/status.
